post.instagram_caption:
The US just proposed new tariffs on 14 economies. The highest: up to 35%.

On Nov 25, 2026, the US Trade Representative proposed Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies, including China, the EU, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, India and Vietnam. Proposed rates: 15% for the EU, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan; up to 20% for China, on top of its 2018 tariffs; up to 25% for India; up to 35% for Vietnam, or 20% with a deal. None of it is in effect yet: comments close Jan 5, 2027 and a public hearing starts Jan 25, 2027.

post.youtube_description:
On Nov 25, 2026, the US Trade Representative proposed Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies over structural excess capacity: 15% for the EU, Japan, South Korea, Switzerland and Taiwan; up to 18% for Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand; up to 20% for Singapore; up to 25% for India; up to 35% for Vietnam (20% with a deal); and up to 20% for China on top of its 2018 tariffs. Mexico and Norway were investigated but not included. The rates are proposals, not in effect: comments are due Jan 5, 2027 and a hearing starts Jan 25, 2027. Education only, not financial advice.
